title: Tangent cones to Schubert varieties for Kac--Moody groups
summary: Let $G$ be the affine Kac--Moody group of type $\widetilde A_{n-1}$, $B$ be an Iwahori subgroup in $G$, $\mathcal{F}=G/B$ be the flag variety, and $W$ be the Weyl group of $G$. Given distinct involutions $w_1$, $w_2\in W$, we prove that the tangent cones $C_{w_1}$, $C_{w_2}$ to the corresponding Schubert subvarieties $X_{w_1}$ and $X_{w_2}$ of $\mathcal{F}$ at the point $p=e\mod B$ do not coincide as subvarieties of the tangent space to $\mathcal{F}$ at the point $p$.
